title: Per-message Cost Playbook: Interactive Cost Attribution, Exports, and Pricing Patterns
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and prototype an exploratory UX within Redwood Console for per-message/token-level cost analysis. The goal is an interactive playbook that lets customers: 1) drill from an application route or API key down to per-message token breakdowns, 2) attribute cost across prompt/prefix/response segments and user cohorts, 3) export structured billing narratives (CSV / Parquet) and human-readable chargeback reports, and 4) preview pricing pattern changes (slab presets, per-token adjustments) with immediate cost delta simulation. Focus is on role-aware views (owner, finance, developer), compact sparklines for microcost trends, and composable export templates for chargeback automation.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable cost-sankey prototype that maps 'route -> conversation -> message -> token-region' with hover details and link-to-export
Export formats supported: CSV (tabular), Parquet (analytics), and a human-readable chargeback PDF template
Pricing simulator panel that accepts a pricing preset and shows projected monthly delta for selected route/cohort
Role-aware UI states: Developer (detailed token breakdown), Finance (aggregated chargeback view), Admin (export controls + ratecard editing stub)
Design spec includes accessibility checks (color contrast for heatmaps, keyboard navigation for drilldowns) and responsive behavior for 1280px and 1440px widths
Handoff-ready Figma screens and a concise dev checklist with data contract fields for export and attribution endpoints
design_notes: Key trade-offs discussed: 1) inline versus modal export flow — chose inline drawer to maintain context during iterative simulations; 2) Sankey depth — limited to three levels by default to avoid cognitive overload, with 'expand deeper' controls for advanced users; 3) Live pricing simulation will be optimistic by default (no SLA guarantees) and annotated accordingly. We recommend server-provided aggregation endpoints: /costs/attribution?granularity=message|token and /billing/export?format=csv|parquet to keep client simple.
